title: Implement cached-first Stage 0 screen execution with durable separate ledgers
description: Compose frozen first1500 reviews manifest, deterministic agreement100 and 300heldout x S/F600 one-call native Jev decisions, read-only SME cache, durable separate SME/Jev ledger caps and new Stage0 evidence contract. Replay/preflight must never construct live clients or read env. Live misses require explicit model, confirm and max-new ceiling validated before client creation; record every missing/failed/malformed cell without successful-only metrics. Private resume answer cache contains sanitized structured results not review/policy prose; public artifact text-free hashes/counts/metrics/decision. Bind S/F question fingerprints and models, source split/policy hashes. No Stage1 authorization emitted; STOP for owner after real Stage0 screen. Existing rubric_screen utility does not satisfy durable spend or complete matrix and is not the runner. Specs first fake clients; no paid calls while implementing. Coordinate pending frozen manifest API, no dynamic repartition fallback. No dollar price invention; existing approved total budget and stage-specific ceilings remain binding.
